name: Runge-Kutta steps: Bogacki-Shampine, RK4, RKF45, dynamic RK
plain: Classic Runge-Kutta steps applied to the sigma ODE. Bogacki-Shampine uses three slopes (two extra calls) and can add a reversible correction; RK4 uses four; rkf45 uses the six Fehlberg stages but keeps only the fourth-order answer, with no step-size control; rk_dynamic picks its order from how much the prediction changed since the last step.
math:
Symbols: d slope (x − D)/σ; Δ = σ↓ − σ.
RK4: k₁ = dΔ; k₂ = d(x + k₁/2)Δ; k₃ = d(x + k₂/2)Δ; k₄ = d(x + k₃)Δ; x' = x + (k₁ + 2k₂ + 2k₃ + k₄)/6.
Bogacki: x' = x + 2k₁/9 + k₂/3 + 4k₃/9 (minus a reversible term).
RKF45: x' = x + 25k₁/216 + 1408k₃/2565 + 2197k₄/4104 − k₅/5.
